SUMMARY: PillowFactory builds ONE soft throw pillow as a single mesh object. It creates a base shape (square/rectangle/circle/torus), solidifies it, runs a cloth simulation with internal pressure to inflate it into a plush pillow, optionally adds a central seam and an extruded rim, then assigns a fabric material. The other clothes files (blanket, pants, shirt) are sibling factories in the linked module tree and are not used by this pillow output. For the requested "small square throw pillow", force self.shape="square" and tune width down for the compact appearance.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/seating/pillow.py
  PillowFactory.shapes: weighted shape selector (sampled randomly via rg)
    knobs: square(weight 4), rectangle(weight 4), circle(weight 1), torus(weight 1) -> which pillow silhouette. For a guaranteed square throw pillow, set self.shape="square" in __init__ or make shapes only ("weighted_choice",(1,"square")).
  PillowFactory.__init__: per-instance geometry/material sampling (mostly random)
    knobs: self.width(uniform 0.4-0.7) -> overall pillow footprint; lower (~0.4) = compact/small
    knobs: self.size(=width for square, else width*log_uniform(0.6,0.8)) -> aspect for non-square; square keeps size==width
    knobs: self.bevel_width(uniform 0.02-0.05) -> declared but unused in create_asset (no effect)
    knobs: self.thickness(log_uniform 0.006-0.008) -> flat pre-inflation shell thickness (SOLIDIFY)
    knobs: self.extrude_thickness(thickness*log_uniform(1,8) with 50% prob, else 0) -> adds raised piped rim; 0 = plain edge
    knobs: self.has_seam(uniform<0.3 and not torus) -> whether a pinned center seam dimple is created
    knobs: self.seam_radius(uniform 0.01-0.02) -> size of central seam/pin region
    knobs: self.surface(weighted_sample(material_assignments.fabrics)) -> fabric material (random); ArtFabric gets factory_seed
  PillowFactory.create_asset: mesh build + cloth inflation
    knobs: circle/torus base vertices(128 fixed) -> smoothness of round shapes
    knobs: torus inner radius(uniform 0.2-0.4) -> hole size of torus pillow
    knobs: torus bridge number_cuts(12) -> torus ring resolution
    knobs: grid x/y_subdivisions(32) -> square/rectangle mesh resolution (higher = softer folds)
    knobs: pressure(torus uniform 8-12; else uniform 1-2) -> puffiness/inflation amount; raise for fatter pillow
    knobs: cloth_sim tension_stiffness(uniform 0-5) -> how tight/wrinkled the fabric inflates
    knobs: cloth_sim gravity(0 fixed) -> no sag; increase for slumped look
    knobs: subsurf level(2 fixed) -> final surface smoothing
    knobs: select_faces normal[:,-1]<0.1 -> which side faces are simulated (side seam band)
  PillowFactory.make_circle / make_gird: helper builders (currently unused by create_asset) — safe to ignore/repurpose
  PillowFactory.finalize_assets: assigns self.surface material to the returned object(s)

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/scatters/clothes.py -> cloth_sim(): wraps Blender cloth modifier w/ pressure & pinning to inflate the pillow
  assets/composition/material_assignments.py -> fabrics / blanket / pants weighted material generator pools
  assets/materials/art.py -> ArtFabric procedural fabric material (seeded)
  assets/materials/fabric/*.py -> concrete fabric shaders (knit, leather, rug, sofa fabric)
  assets/utils/object.py -> new_grid, new_base_circle, join_objects, center primitives/utilities
  assets/utils/decorate.py -> read_normal, read_selected, select_faces, set_shade_smooth, subsurf mesh ops
  assets/utils/uv.py -> unwrap_faces UV unwrapping
  core/surface.py -> assign_material application
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class / create_asset contract
  core/util/random.py -> random_general(rg), weighted_sample, log_uniform samplers
  core/util/blender.py -> ViewportMode, apply_transform, modify_mesh, Suppress helpers
  core/nodes/*, core/tags.py, core/placement/detail.py -> node graph engine, tagging, LOD infra
  assets/objects/clothes/{blanket,pants,shirt}.py -> sibling garment factories (not invoked by PillowFactory)
  assets/objects/creatures/util/cloth_sim.py -> alternate creature-cloth baking utility (unused here)
